description: The Phase 1 exit demo: a 36 by 24 ft single-storey house of 2x6 exterior walls (siding, OSB, studs, drywall; justified on the exterior face of the studs and drawn clockwise) and 2x4 partitions. A living room open to the kitchen across a separator, a bedroom behind a partition, a front door, an interior door and four windows. Dimensions are feet and inches in base units (1 ft = 390,144, 1 in = 32,512). The exterior tees are butt joins with the exterior walls running through; the corners and the interior tee are mitred. The input is deliberately not canonical - member order, four-space indentation, constant defaults written out - so canonical.json is a real re-serialization.
